title: Configure postgresql19c
description: Choose the role of the instance (standalone server, first member of a new cluster, member or witness of an existing cluster) and its settings

role.description: standalone: one server. initial: first member of a new cluster, other instances can join it. join: become a PostgreSQL replica of the cluster cluster_id. witness: an etcd voter of cluster_id without PostgreSQL (the third vote of a two-node cluster). A member that becomes standalone leaves its cluster and restarts empty

cluster_id.description: With join or witness: the cluster to join (get-configuration cluster_candidates)

replication_mode.description: Cluster-wide. async (default): a failover can lose the last transactions not yet replicated. sync: a commit waits for one synchronous replica, and only that replica can be promoted

max_connections.description: Cluster-wide max_connections; members restart one at a time when it changes

allow_same_node.description: With initial: let several members run on the same node. For tests only: such a cluster survives no node failure

host.description: pgAdmin host name, published by Traefik

vault_enabled.description: Keep the shared secrets in OpenBao or Vault KV v2 (a local copy is always kept)

vault_auth.description: token: the pasted vault_token (default); provisioned: the module's own token issued by the ns8-openbao instance vault_provider (client provisioning). The shared secrets then go to the group postgresql19c-<cluster id>-peers

vault_provider.description: Module ID of the ns8-openbao instance of provisioned mode, e.g. openbao1

vault_copy_to_local.description: When turning OpenBao off: copy the OpenBao-only secrets to local files first

public_access_enabled.description: Direct database access from outside the NethServer cluster: opens the public endpoint port (TLS only) of this instance in the node firewall. Per instance

public_access_allowlist.description: IPv4 addresses or networks allowed on the public endpoint; empty: any source

pgadmin_path.description: Publish pgAdmin under this path instead of (or with) a host name, e.g. /pgadmin

pgadmin_ip_allowlist.description: Source addresses allowed to reach pgAdmin (Traefik ip_allowlist); empty: any
